LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MiraboreasBloodline.label: [Raven] Black Dragon Bloodline
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_MiraboreasBloodline.descrip:
A bloodline mixed with the legendary ancient dragon Miraboreasu, granting a fraction of its devastating power.

Effects:
- Completely immune to hit stun.
- When attacking with a melee weapon, has a chance to trigger "Slam", dealing impact damage to enemies in a small area around the target.
